main_claim: His friend Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is fine, physically and mentally strong, resting after his June fractures and will beat everyone when he returns.
note: The new content is Dvalishvili, named as 'su amigo', telling Helen Yee 'Topuria está bien y tiene una actitud muy positiva... es muy fuerte, tanto física como mentalmente' while he rests for the fractures to heal: a named person saying how he is, so health at firmness reported; an editor could read it as status_update (resting, enjoying life, back on social media) or as mere opinion (no_fact, 'les ganará a todos'), which would make the act assesses_him and health no.
